targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name = 'graphiti.add_episode' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1' HOUR
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name = 'graphiti.search' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1' HOUR
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name = 'graphiti.llm.generate' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1' HOUR
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name LIKE 'graphiti.episode.%write%' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1' HOUR
SELECT trace_id, span_name, duration_nano/1000000 AS duration_ms, span_status_code, timestamp FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE span_name LIKE 'graphiti.%' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT span_name, count(*) AS calls, round(avg(duration_nano)/1000000, 1) AS avg_ms, round(max(duration_nano)/1000000, 1) AS max_ms FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1' HOUR GROUP BY span_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT trace_id, span_name, service_name, duration_nano/1000000 AS duration_ms, span_status_code, timestamp FROM opentelemetry_traces ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 30
